title: Improve Queue File Settings drawer action feedback
summary: Implement the Queue file-overrides UI/UX review quick wins for action feedback, dirty-state guarding, and saved-policy clearing semantics.
reason: The File Settings drawer placed save/clear feedback below a long scroll, allowed silent discard of typed changes, and could make neutral saved-policy selections look like a no-op instead of a field clear.
behavior_before: Save/Clear status rendered as an uncolored note below the folder-rule panels, Escape/overlay/close discarded unsaved edits without warning, Save stayed enabled when no form changes existed, and neutral saved fields could fall into a no-op path.
behavior_after: The drawer has a sticky action/status footer with role-aware success/error/warning/working tones, Save enables only for dirty forms, Escape/overlay/close and full Clear guard unsaved edits, and saved file-override fields that are returned to neutral send clear_fields on Save.
tests_added: DesktopApp/tests/test_application_facade_web_static.py assertions for sticky drawer action footer, semantic status tones, dirty-state helpers, discard guard, and clear-on-save helper selection
manual_validation: DesktopApp/Runtime/Python/python.exe -m pytest DesktopApp/tests/test_application_facade_web_static.py -q -- passed, 38 passed and 6 subtests passed
DesktopApp/Runtime/Python/python.exe scripts/dev/refresh_summaries.py --paths <queue drawer files, browser smoke, wrapper, packet> -- passed, 6 written and 1 unchanged
rollback_plan: Revert the drawer footer markup/styles, status/dirty-state JavaScript helpers, browser smoke, static test assertions, and this change packet.
notes: WebView-only Queue drawer interaction change. It uses the existing backend clear_fields command and does not change FFmpeg command generation, route policy, subtitle policy, audio policy, queue launch, pending publish drain, source/scratch/output movement, cleanup behavior, or source media files. Affected Python scripts: DesktopApp/tests/test_application_facade_web_static.py and DesktopApp/tests/test_webview_browser_queue_file_overrides_smoke.py.
